imagesRecorded.source: Exact count of every 2026 Emerald Queen frame transferred from the cameras' SD cards, counted inside the raw ZIPs and de-duplicated by camera, date and timestamp, with empty files skipped. That is 3,278,875 frames from the May–August archive (62 ZIPs on the lab NAS, 84 on the Expansion drive) and 376,042 from the late-July California cards, over 1,142 camera-days from May 2 to August 23. One camera-day with a reset clock is included. The Oregon clover timelapse cameras are counted separately on the Clover cams tab.

humanReviewed.source: bombus_cascade live manifest (curation_20261026T192955.csv), 2026 Emerald Queen rows with review_state annotated or reviewed_negative. The Oregon clover review adds 1,510 more (596 with insects, 914 background), not counted here.

confirmedBombus.source: bombus_cascade live manifest, 2026 annotated rows outside the excluded split with at least one human Bombus (class 0) box. Exported by scripts/export_cascade_positives.py; excludes frames curated as test images.
